description: Documentation coverage checks for WCAG 2.2 Web Content Accessibility Guidelines. Checks whether accessibility requirements are identified and described in the project artifacts.

rules.title: Keyboard Navigation
rules.description: All interactive functionality must be accessible via keyboard.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for keyboard navigation, tab order, focus management, or keyboard shortcut mentions.
rules.recommendation: Document keyboard navigation requirements, tab order, and any keyboard shortcuts or focus management.

rules.title: Screen Reader & Assistive Technology
rules.description: Content must be compatible with screen readers and assistive technology.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for screen reader support, ARIA landmark usage, or assistive technology compatibility.
rules.recommendation: Document screen reader support, ARIA landmark usage, and assistive technology compatibility requirements.

rules.title: Alternative Text for Non-Text Content
rules.description: Images and media must provide text alternatives.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for alt text requirements, image descriptions, or media accessibility mentions.
rules.recommendation: Specify alt text requirements for images, videos, and other non-text content.

rules.title: Color Contrast
rules.description: Text and UI elements must meet minimum contrast ratio requirements.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for color contrast requirements, contrast ratio specifications, or WCAG AA/AAA mentions.
rules.recommendation: Document minimum contrast ratio requirements (WCAG AA: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text).

rules.title: Visible Focus Indicators
rules.description: All focusable elements must have a visible focus indicator.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for focus state, focus ring, or focus indicator requirements.
rules.recommendation: Document visible focus indicator requirements for all interactive elements.

rules.title: Accessible Error Messages
rules.description: Error messages must be descriptive and accessible to assistive technology.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for accessible error message requirements, ARIA error associations, or screen reader notifications.
rules.recommendation: Describe how error messages are communicated to screen reader users and keyboard navigators.
